description.value: Coastal Olive Oils Co. is a family-owned specialty tasting room in Tsawwassen that stocks around 40 extra virgin, fused, and infused olive oils alongside balsamic vinegars sourced from Modena, Italy. Customers are invited to sample before buying, giving it the feel of a curated food-experience shop rather than a grocery. The shop also carries artisanal Pappardelle's pasta and offers home delivery to Tsawwassen and Ladner.
